versions.content: Extension of existing hardware categories An existing hardware category can be extended with new attribute definitions. The exten- sion is via defining a hardware category of the same name as the standardized one in a different package than AUTOSAR . A HwDescriptionEntity shall then reference the standardized and the extended hardware category.
